scripts.build:fable: rm -rf build && dotnet fable src/App -o build/fable
scripts.build: npm run build:fable --silent && rm -rf dist && esbuild build/fable/Main.js --bundle --format=cjs --outfile=dist/main.js
scripts.test: npm run format:check --silent && npm run adr-check --silent && dotnet test && npm run wire --silent && node scripts/cli-smoke.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run upload
